text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with Sakura Laurel, we 
decided to run in the Kikuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The attending physician gave me the 
official green light, saying there's no 
problem at all!
choice_data_list:
Your legs seem to be in better shape than 
before.

Your legs seem to be in better shape than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've been having them gradually 
increase my training load, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"If you have strength to spare, let us 
make the utmost use of this opportunity!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day, one week before the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...—Wait, this news...

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was 
scheduled to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), has announced in a press 
conference that she will be temporarily 
hospitalized."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san! A temporary 
hospitalization... were you injured 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No. I simply decided to focus on 
recovery so that I can take on the 
challenge in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to this year's intense heat, 
my condition has dropped a little. I'm 
hoping to get back on track at this time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to be discharged on the day 
of the Kikuka-sho. After the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), there's the Arima Kinen with 
Brian, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're looking forward to it too, aren't 
you, Hayahide-chan? The sister showdown 
against Brian-chan, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder which one will win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, Sakura Laurel and I can't help 
but feel growing anticipation for the 
battles to come. Yet on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of comments were flying across 
the internet regarding Biwa Hayahide's 
temporary hospitalization.

text_block_list.name: Internet Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Why is Hayahide being hospitalized?" 
"She's just resting up for the Arima, 
she'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Internet Comment
text_block_list.text:
"During the press conference, it felt like 
her muscles lacked tone." "Honestly, even 
Brian must be worried."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, there still hasn't been any 
update on Hayahide, huh... Even though she 
was supposed to be discharged today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said, it'll be on the news once 
they're discharged! More importantly, 
let's watch Brian!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
If it's Lady Brian, she will be fine. As 
long as it's Lady Brian, everything will 
be alright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, the stands were filled with a 
strange atmosphere, tinged with a hint of 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though Hayahide-chan properly 
explained at the press conference that it 
was 'to challenge it in peak condition.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, my mind is made up! I'm going to 
give everyone who came today a piece of my 
mind!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Don't let your eyes wander! Be captivated 
by our running instead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Even Brian-chan has to hate this kind 
of atmosphere.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Having people say whatever they want 
about Hayahide-chan and giving her 
unneeded pity like that—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooo...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WAAAAH!! BRIAN!! YOU CAN DO ITTT!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...! The atmosphere in the paddock is 
completely different from the 
grandstands...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO! Briaaaan! Show us the run of 
the strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is captivated by Brian-chan. No 
one is worried at all..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Maybe I was worrying for 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Just by standing there, you make 
everyone's eyes light up."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—...I have to chase after it. After your 
radiance.
